p0463, the simile governing the second of the three intentions: the bodhisattva holds his own remaining goods as a deposit belonging to beings. No entry; rendered literally (བཅོལ་བ = thing entrusted, ལེན་པ = one who takes/receives).
p0462, in the Sharawa saying (ཤ་ཐང་ཐང་དུ་ནོར་བཙལ་ཞིང་བསགས་ནས). Colloquial intensive of ཤ་ཐང 'exhaustion'; rendered descriptively. See flag — the intensive reduplication is not certain.

p0464, དགའ་བའི་བསམ་པ → "ý lạc hỷ" (l.94), third of the four immeasurables. No entry. The chunk already follows the fixed བྱམས་པ → "từ", the fixed སྙིང་རྗེ → "bi" and བཏང་སྙོམས → "xả" in the same sentence; "hỷ" completes the set. Note the existing བཏང་སྙོམས entry is scoped by its own note to the neutral *feeling* (p0305), so the immeasurable sense of བཏང་སྙོམས used here should be registered at the same time.

p0461, སྦྱིན་བྱ་སྦྱིན་བྱེད་ལེན་པ་པོ་རྣམས — the third of the three spheres of giving. The glossary's composite entry སྦྱིན་བྱ / སྦྱིན་བྱེད / སྦྱིན་རྫས covers the first two members but has nothing for the recipient. "người nhận" is kept; register it so the triad is complete and stays parallel with "đối tượng thí" / "người thí".

terms.vi: hàng cư sĩ → "bồ-tát hàng cư sĩ" / "bồ-tát thuộc hàng cư sĩ"
terms.kind: scope note on an existing entry
terms.note: The recorded vi is "hàng cư sĩ", a plural-class noun. p0461-p0462 uses it in two compounds needing a singular reading (ཁྱིམ་པའི་བྱང་སེམས, བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའི་ཁྱིམ་པ་གང་གིས), rendered "bồ-tát hàng cư sĩ" and "một vị bồ-tát thuộc hàng cư sĩ". Worth recording the compound form. The entry's own note already flags a collision with དགེ་བསྙེན = "cận sự nam" / ཁྱིམ་བདག = "trưởng giả" and suggests "hàng tại gia" as the alternative; if that alternative is ever adopted, this chunk is one of the lines to sweep.

p0503, ×3 (prose sub-topic label + Bodhicaryāvatāra verse), contrasted throughout with རང་བཞིན. No entry in glossary.json. Deliberately NOT the Sino-Vietnamese 'khách trần', which belongs to གློ་བུར་གྱི་དྲི་མ (adventitious defilement) and would import a defilement-word the Tibetan does not have here. Recurs constantly later in the book, so it wants a central ruling.

terms.bo: རང་བཞིན (of sentient beings, contrasted with གློ་བུར་བ)
terms.note: p0503, ×4. glossary.json fixes རང་བཞིན = 'tự tánh' (status fixed, count 799), and I used the fixed form. Recording only that here the sense is the innate character of beings and of fire ('fire whose nature is to burn'), not Madhyamaka svabhāva; a Phase 5 reader should know the fixed word is being carried into the ordinary-nature sense on purpose, not by inattention.

terms.bo: རྟེན (in the ཡུལ / ཡུལ་ཅན / རྟེན triad)
terms.note: p0506. glossary.json has རྟེན = 'thân y' (provisional, the physical basis for practice) with a note that c028 uses 'sở y' for a different sense. Here 'sở y' (matching c153) is right and 'thân y' would be wrong: the section covers both the body AND one's own bodhisattva pledge, so 'thân' would over-specify. Register as a scoped third case.

p0506. No entry. Occurs at p0276, p0351, p0451, p0468, p0514, p0516 as well, so it will recur; c108 rendered the p0351 use with 'kham nhẫn'. 'sức bền bỉ' chosen here because it stands in genitive to བཟོད་པ = 'nhẫn' and 'sức kham nhẫn của nhẫn' would be a tautology. Needs one ruling covering all occurrences.

terms.vi: quy lỗi về nơi chính mình
terms.note: p0504. ལེ་ལན (blame/requital) also occurs at p0250. Rendered as a phrase rather than a term because the Tibetan is idiomatic ('drive the blame [onto oneself]'); the preceding རང་གིས་ལན་པ is rendered 'điều chính mình phải gánh lấy'.

p0505, རང་གིས་རང་ལ་ཁྲེལ་དེད་དེ. Follows the glossary's ཁྲེལ་ཆུང་བ / ཁྲེལ་བོར note, which reserves the technical ཁྲེལ་ཡོད་པ = 'quý' for Abhidharma mental-factor lists and uses ordinary 'hổ thẹn' for moral rebuke. This is moral rebuke.

p0505-p0506, the medical simile for enduring small pain to avert great pain. གཏར = lancing/bloodletting, སྲེག = burning/moxibustion. Rendered as two Vietnamese nouns because the Tibetan compound joins two procedures; '[huyệt]' bracketed because the Tibetan says only 'burning'.
p0506, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse ཤུ་བ་མི་ཡི་གཟུགས་འདྲ་བ — the body as a boil in human shape. No entry.

terms.vi: con trâu yak bị tuột yên
terms.note: p0506, closing Potowa simile. གཡག = 'trâu yak' per the existing glossary entry (whose own note says the simile depends on the tail). སྒ = 'yên' (pack-saddle); བོག་པ = slipped/come loose. The simile runs into p0507 and is completed in the next chunk.

p0506, chunk-final, sentence completes on p0507. Read as 'to match / contend with [him]' (be his counterpart in retaliation), which is what the yak simile and the p0507 continuation ཇེ་མི་བདེར་འགྲོ ('it goes ever more uncomfortable') support. The alternative sense of ཟླ་བྱེད, 'to keep company with', would invert the passage — see flag.

terms.vi: sự suy tàn nơi phần riêng
terms.note: p0506, closing Potowa's saying, opposed to སྤྱིའི་བསྟན་པ = 'giáo pháp chung'. སྒོས = particular/one's own, as against སྤྱི = general; ནུབ = to sink/decline. Rendered so the general/particular opposition the saying turns on stays visible.

p0504 l.3, ཤ་པོ་བའི་ཞལ་ནས་ཀྱང༌། A hapax: this is the ONLY occurrence in the whole 978-page corpus. The registered ཤ་ར་བ = 'ngài Sharawa' occurs 8× (p0076, p0193, p0198, p0325, p0344, p0531, p0540, p0561) and is a DIFFERENT spelling. Register ཤ་པོ་བ separately as transcribed-as-printed, so the corpus does not silently normalise a hapax into an already-registered name. If the project later rules that this is a misprint for ཤ་ར་བ, that ruling must be recorded explicitly, not applied silently; the inline translator's note in c154 should then be updated.

terms.bo: རྟེན (sense: the support/basis of the harm — body and weapon)
terms.note: c154 L119 sa-bcad རྟེན་ལ་བརྟགས་ན་ཁྲོ་བར་མི་རིགས་པ (p0506 l.3) = 'xét về sở y thì nổi giận là không hợp lý'. WORDING KEPT — this is a THIRD sense, distinct from the two already noted. glossary.json rules རྟེན = 'thân y' (provisional) but its own note scopes that to the physical basis for practice (11× in p0114–p0116), and records that c028 uses 'sở y' for རྟེན as a physical representation. Here རྟེན is the third member of the ཡུལ / ཡུལ་ཅན / རྟེན triad — the support of the harm, i.e. the victim's body and the aggressor's weapon (the verses that follow are BCA VI.43–44, མཚོན and ལུས). Precedent already set by c153 l.62, which announces the same three-fold division as 'xét về cảnh, về hữu cảnh, và về sở y'. Needs a scoped entry so the heading stays stable across c153/c154; 'thân y' would be positively wrong here, since the weapon is not a 'thân'.

c154 L11, L14, L23 (p0503 l.1, incl. the BCA VI.39 pair གློ་བུར་བ vs རང་བཞིན). NO entry exists for གློ་བུར་བ or གློ་བུར. WORDING KEPT per the repair rule, but this one genuinely deserves a ruling before it spreads: 'ngẫu nhiên' means 'accidental / by chance', whereas the term's Buddhist sense is 'adventitious' — arriving from outside, not belonging to the thing's own nature. It is the whole hinge of the argument here, since it is the explicit contrary of རང་བཞིན (fixed = 'tự tánh', correctly used). Candidates: 'khách' / 'khách trần' (the established Sino-Vietnamese for the compound གློ་བུར་གྱི་དྲི་མ = khách trần cấu), or 'ngoại lai', or 'bất chợt'. A ruling should also cover the compound with དྲི་མ, which will recur in the śamatha/vipaśyanā chapters.

terms.bo: ཁྲོ་བ (verbal use: ཁྲོ་བར་མི་རིགས / ཁྲོ་དགོས / ཁྲོ་བར་བྱ / ཁྲོ་ན)
terms.note: WORDING KEPT — see 'remaining'. glossary.json rules ཁྲོ་བ = 'sân giận' (provisional) and its own note already asks for 'a ruling covering ཞེ་སྡང / ཁྲོ་བ / ཁོང་ཁྲོ together'; that gap is still open and c154 is the densest occurrence of the pair in the book. c154 splits by morphology: nominal ཁྲོ་བ = 'sân giận' (L16, 55, 88, 93), verbal ཁྲོ་བར་མི་རིགས etc. = 'nổi giận' (20+). The split is what keeps ཞེ་སྡང = 'sân hận' (registered) legible where the two words are contrasted in one sentence (p0503 l.3, ཞེ་སྡང་ལ་ཁྲོ་དགོས — 'phải nổi giận với sân hận'; collapsing to one word would give 'phải sân giận với sân hận'). Requested ruling: register 'nổi giận' as the verbal form of ཁྲོ་བ under the existing entry (a viVariants / fixed-set style scoping), or overrule it and specify what the verbal form should be.

c154 L108, p0505 l.3 འཇུག་པ་ལས་ཀྱང༌། WORDING KEPT — the expansion is correct (the verse quoted is MAv VI.130) and follows the སྤྱོད་འཇུག precedent, but only the FULL title དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ is registered. Register the bare short-form citation explicitly. This also touches the unresolved short-vs-full-title policy already flagged under the ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས entry — a single ruling could close both: short-form Tibetan citations are expanded to the full registered Vietnamese title.

p0505 l.1, in the Shapowa saying. Not a standard form; the expected words are བག་ཚ (apprehension) or བག་ཡོད (conscientiousness). Left untranslated behind an unclear-sense bracket rather than resolved. Compounding this, the genitive ཆོས་ཀྱི་ reads either possessive ('the Dharma's restraint in one') or objective ('apprehension toward the Dharma'); the neutral possessive is used and the ambiguity is stated inline. Needs either an editorial ruling on the reading or confirmation that it stays unresolved into Phase 5.

p0506 l.3, in the Potowa saying, standing alone as a two-syllable sentence after འདིས་བསྟན་པ་རྩ་བ་ནས་བཤིག་ཟེར།. བྲུབ་པ is an obscure colloquialism here (attested senses run from 'demolish/raze' to 'trample down'); no rendering is decisive and none is supplied. Left as an unclear-sense bracket. Needs a ruling, ideally against a Kadampa-sayings gloss.

p0521. Chapter of Asaṅga's Bodhisattvabhūmi (བྱང་ས, already registered), cited here as the authority that makes the eighth object of མོས་པ the twelve-limbed saddharma rather than impermanence. རིགས = chủng tánh (gotra), སྟོབས = lực per the existing སྟོབས entry. Italicised as a cited title.

p0521, in སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཟག་པ་ཟད་པའི་བཟོད་པ་ལ་འགོད་པར་འདོད་པ. Here ཟག་པ IS āsrava, so 'lậu' applies, consistent with the registered ཟག་པ་དང་བཅས་པ = hữu lậu and deliberately unlike ཟག་པ་ཆུང་འབྲིང = sai phạm. The parallel śīla summary (p0490 / c150) has no counterpart phrase, so this is first occurrence.

terms.vi: nhẫn của lòng tin ưa đối với sự tư duy xác quyết về pháp
terms.note: p0520, the third of the three kṣānti, and its contracted form ཆོས་ལ་ངེས་སེམས (p0521) rendered 'sự tư duy xác quyết về pháp'. Built from the registered མོས་པ = lòng tin ưa and ངེས་པ = sự xác quyết. This is the doctrinal, name-of-a-category use of མོས་པ that the glossary's own note says may want 'thắng giải' instead — see flags.

p0519-p0520, spelled སློངས་མོས in the source. Fifth of the eight bases of suffering to be accepted. Uses 'khất thực', the same word the glossary gives for བསོད་སྙོམས (piṇḍapāta); the two do not co-occur in this chunk but a ruling should say whether they may share one Vietnamese word or whether one takes a distinguishing form.
p0520. The eleven activities for beings' welfare from the Bodhisattvabhūmi; the source only names the number and does not enumerate them, so nothing was supplied.
p0520, eighth of the eight bases. Kept literal ('phral = immediate/current) rather than 'công việc thường nhật'.

terms.vi: sự mỏi mệt do tinh cần
terms.note: p0520, sixth of the eight bases. བརྩོན་པ kept as 'tinh cần' to leave 'tinh tấn' to the fixed བརྩོན་འགྲུས, which occurs six lines later in the same paragraph (སོ་སོའི་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་མི་གཏོང).
p0519, fourth of the eight bases; its contracted form ཆོས་འཛིན་པ་བདུན rendered 'bảy [điều] thọ trì pháp' so the two read as one term.
p0521, བཞེད་དོ. Follows c005 line 76, which already uses 'đại sư Drolungpa'; recorded here only because there is no glossary entry.
p0520, རྒྱལ་པོ་ལ་ཞོ་ཤས་འཚོ་བ = 'việc phục dịch nhà vua mà sinh sống'. ཞོ་ཤ = service/wages rendered by the service sense; no entry exists.

p0521, `སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཟག་པ་ཟད་པའི་བཟོད་པ་ལ་འགོད་པ`. First occurrence in the corpus; no entry. Here ཟག་པ is āsrava, so 'lậu' applies — this aligns with the ཟག་བཅས -> 'hữu lậu' entries and must NOT be collided with the glossary's ཟག་པ (in ཟག་པ་ཆུང་འབྲིང) -> 'sai phạm', which is the Vinaya-infraction sense. Text KEPT.

p0520, third of the three མཐུ (`མངོན་པར་ཤེས་པའི་མཐུ་དང་ཕར་ཕྱིན་དྲུག་གི་མཐུ་དང་ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པའི་མཐུ་གསུམ`). Only ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པའི་ཤེས་རབ -> 'trí tuệ câu sinh' exists. 'câu sinh' for ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པ is consistent with it. Text KEPT.

p0509, third of the three Kadam masters Sharawa names alongside ཁམ་ལུང་པ (Khamlungpa) and སྣེའུ་ཟུར་པ (Neusurpa), both already registered. Left in Tibetan transcription like the rest of the Kadam names.
p0509, subject of the second anecdote Sharawa relates. No entry. 'ngài' added on the pattern of the registered པོ་ཏོ་བ = 'ngài Potowa' / ཤ་ར་བ = 'ngài Sharawa'.

p0510, the middle member of the triad བརྙས་པ / སྨད་པ / མི་སྙན་པ་སྨྲ་བ which this whole subsection is about. No entry. Deliberately kept distinct from the registered བརྙས་པ = 'khinh miệt' and from མི་སྙན་པ = 'lời khó nghe' (registered as མི་སྙན་པའི་སྒྲ) so the three stay separable.

p0507, twice, in the two sa-bcad headings of this subsection. No entry. Kept distinct from བར་ཆད = 'chướng ngại' (p0510), which is a different Tibetan word appearing in the same discussion; one ruling should cover both.
p0510 prose (རྙེད་པ་འཐོབ་པའི་བར་ཆད) and verse (རྙེད་པའི་བར་ཆད་བྱེད་པའི་ཕྱིར). No entry. See the གེགས note — the pair must not collapse onto one Vietnamese word.

p0507-p0508, ×5. No entry for either. གྲགས་སྙན (p0508, in the triad བསྟོད་པ / གྲགས་སྙན / རྙེད་བཀུར) is given 'danh thơm' so the སྙན element is not lost. Note the potential clash with the registered person name རྗེ་བློ་བཟང་གྲགས་པ, which is unrelated.

p0507-p0508, ×7, and in three Bodhicaryāvatāra verses. glossary.json registers བསྟོད་པ = 'tán thán' but its note scopes it to p0401, བསྟོད་པ་བྱའོ, the ritual act of praising the Buddha. Here it is praise received from other people. The same Vietnamese was used rather than coining a second word; record whether the entry covers both senses or needs splitting (e.g. 'lời tán dương' for praise received).

p0507 prose (བྱིས་པ་ཆུང་ངུ་རྣམས་ངུ་བ) and p0508 verse (བྱིས་པ་རྣམས་ནི་ག་ཆད་ངུ་ / རང་གི་སེམས་ནི་བྱིས་པ་བཞིན). glossary.json registers བྱིས་པ = 'kẻ ngu' (bāla, from the Udānavarga pair with བརྟན་པ). That reading is impossible here: the children are crying over a collapsed sand house. A sense split is needed, not a substitution.

p0507, in ཕ་མ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་གཉེན་དང་མཛའ་བོ. Built on the registered མཛའ་བ = 'tình thân' and མཛའ་བཤེས = 'thân hữu'; kept distinct from གཉེན = 'người thân' (registered under དགྲ་གཉེན), which stands beside it in the same phrase.

p0508, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse མི་གཏོང་སྒོ་འཕར་ཉིད་གྱུར་པ. Literally the leaf/panel or bar of a door. Rendered simply 'cánh cửa' because the prose gloss immediately above uses plain སྒོ (སྡུག་བསྔལ་ལ་འཇུག་པར་འདོད་པའི་སྒོ་འགེགས་བྱེད), also 'cánh cửa'; a more specific word would make the verse and its gloss look like two different images.
No entry for bare `གྲགས་པ`; glossary only has it inside personal names (`བློ་བཟང་གྲགས་པ`, `ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ`). Used at L28, L46. Recurs.
No entry. Used at L62. Kept visibly distinct from `གྲགས་པ` = 'danh tiếng'; a ruling should decide whether the two stay distinct or collapse.
No entry. p0509, in the Shentön anecdote (`ལོག་ཁ་བཙད་པོ་ལའང་གཏོང་བྱ་བ་ཡིན`). Wording kept.

No entry. p0509. Read as btsan po (king/ruler); the source spells `བཙད་པོ`, which may be the source's own orthography rather than a distinct word — worth a ruling that also records the spelling. Wording kept.

No entry for `གྲོལ་བ`, but its Vietnamese silently coincides with the FIXED entry `ཐར་པ` = 'giải thoát', so two Tibetan words now collapse onto one Vietnamese word. In this chunk (verse, `བདག་ནི་ཐར་པ་འདོད་པ་ལ`-type context at L72) the reading is defensible, but the collision should be ruled on explicitly rather than left implicit.

p0509, `འོ་སྐོལ་ལ་འགབ་མ་ཡང་གྲགས`. Not the standard `འགེབས་པ`/`སྒབ་པ` nominal and not securely readable here. Now left untranslated with an inline flag rather than glossed. If a reading is later established, this is the place to record it.

p0514, twice, in སེམས་ཁྲལ་གྱི་སྡུག་བསྔལ → 'cái khổ lo nghĩ'. No glossary entry. The mental suffering one adds on top of the base suffering by one's own རྟོག་པ (= phân biệt, per glossary). Deliberately not 'ưu não', which would collide with the glossary's ཡིད་མི་བདེ = 'nỗi bất an nơi ý' used in the same chunk.

p0514, སྡུག་བསྔལ་གཉུག་མ → 'cái khổ vốn có' — the innate/original suffering, as against the སེམས་ཁྲལ suffering superimposed on it. Rendered adjectivally rather than with 'bản nhiên', which would read as a tenet term.

p0511-p0512 in the wealth sense (དགྲ་འབྱོར་པ, གཞན་ཅི་འདྲ་ཞིག་གི་འབྱོར་པ, གཞན་འབྱོར). glossary.json rules འབྱོར་པ only inside དལ་འབྱོར, where it is 'thuận duyên' — a different sense. Kept separate so the two do not merge.
p0513-p0514, ×2 (དེ་ལམ་དུ་འཁྱེར་ཤེས་པ, ལམ་དུ་འཁྱེར་ཐབས་བྱས་པ). No glossary entry and no corpus precedent found. Load-bearing for the whole སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་ལེན section that begins here and runs to c158.

p0513, the headword of the second of the three patiences, and repeated as སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་ལེན་གྱི་བཟོད་པ on p0514. Built on c151's already-used 'kham nhận' for དང་ལེན and the fixed བཟོད་པ = 'nhẫn'. It names a division that spans c156-c158, so it must be one form.

p0513, དལ་བའི་རྟེན་ལ་སྙིང་པོ་ལོན་པའི་གེགས. glossary.json has སྙིང་པོ་ལེན་པ = 'lấy tinh túy' (recommended fixed); ལོན་པ is the resultative of the same idiom, so rendered 'đạt được tinh túy' to keep 'tinh túy' stable while marking the difference from ལེན་པ.
p0512. Deliberately NOT the glossary's བསམ་པ = 'ý lạc', which is the āśaya paired with སྦྱོར་བ; here it is the ordinary 'bad thought' (gloating at an enemy's ruin).
p0513, སྲོ་ཤི་བའི་ཞུམ་པ → 'sự khiếp nhược ngã lòng rã rời'. Qualifies ཞུམ་པ, which c151 already renders 'sự khiếp nhược ngã lòng'; kept as a separate word so ཞུམ་པ is not silently absorbed.

p0511, verse: བསྙེན་བཀུར་ངན་ངོན་ཙམ → 'chút phụng sự xoàng xĩnh'. Paired in the surrounding prose with རྙེད་བཀུར་དམན་པ་ཙམ = 'chút ít lợi dưỡng cung kính thấp kém'; the two Tibetan words are kept visibly different.
p0512, verse: གལ་ཏེ་འཚེངས་པར་འགྱུར་ཞེ་ན → 'Nếu bảo rằng [ngươi] sẽ được hả dạ'. Satisfaction/gratification at an enemy's suffering.
p0512, verse: མི་བཟད་གཟེབ → 'cái bẫy chẳng thể chịu nổi'.
p0511, verse: ཆོམ་པོས་ཕྲོགས་པ་ཇི་བཞིན་དུ.
p0511, verse: སྒྲེན་མོ་ལག་པ་སྟོང་པར་འགྲོ → 'Trần trụi, tay không mà đi'.
p0513, བྱང་སེམས་ཀྱི་སྤྱོད་པ་རླབས་ཆེན་པོ. Uses the glossary's སྤྱོད་པ = 'hành vi · hạnh' in its 'hạnh' form; རླབས་ཆེན་པོ rendered 'rộng lớn'.
p0514, སྡུག་བསྔལ་གཞི་བཞག་དེ — the base suffering that is already in place, as against the སེམས་ཁྲལ suffering added on top of it.
p0514, དགོས་ནུས་མེད — the pair 'need and capacity'. Rendered as one Vietnamese phrase; a compact ruling would help since the pair recurs in argumentative passages.

terms.vi: vạc (in a hell context) vs registered "bình"
terms.note: p0512 l1, `སེམས་དམྱལ་བུམ་པར` -> "trong vạc" (line 69). The registered "bình" covers the vessel/vase sense; it does not cover the hell cauldron of this verse, where "vạc" is the correct Vietnamese. Entry needs a context qualification rather than the chunk needing a change.

terms.vi: sân giận / sân hận / phẫn nộ
terms.note: c156 is the passage the `ཁྲོ་བ` note anticipated: all three terms occur within a few lines. `ཁྲོ་བ`/`ཁྲོ་བར་བྱེད` (p0511 l3, prose and verse) -> "nổi sân giận" (lines 24, 34, 42, 45); `ཞེ་སྡང` (p0512 l3) -> "sân hận" (lines 77, 79); `ཁོང་ཁྲོ` (p0512 l3) -> "phẫn nộ" (lines 80, 83, 85, 87). Each matches its registered provisional entry, so no violation and no change made. One joint ruling is still needed, since "sân giận"/"sân hận" are near-indistinguishable in Vietnamese.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học tinh tấn ba-la-mật
terms.note: Outline s181, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.4, the sa-bcad heading this chunk opens on. Built exactly on the sibling headings already translated: c149 'Cách thức tu học giới ba-la-mật' (ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ།) and c151 'Cách thức tu học nhẫn ba-la-mật' (བཟོད་པའི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ།), with the glossary's fixed བརྩོན་འགྲུས = tinh tấn and ཕར་ཕྱིན = ba-la-mật.

p0524, first of the three divisions of vīrya, and the whole subject of the rest of this chunk (used 3×). Built from the glossary's གོ་ཆ = 'áo giáp' (provisional) plus the fixed བརྩོན་འགྲུས = 'tinh tấn'. Deliberately NOT the Sino-Vietnamese 'bị giáp tinh tấn' (被甲精進), so the ordinary word 'áo giáp' stays visible — it is picked up literally two paragraphs later in the Pāramitāsamāsa verse (གོ་ཆ་བརྟན་པ་དཔག་ཡས = 'áo giáp kiên cố vô lượng'). The glossary's note on གོ་ཆ warns against importing an 'armour of aspiration' reading; nothing of the kind was added.

terms.vi: tinh tấn nhiếp thâu thiện pháp
terms.note: p0524, second of the three divisions (announced only; its own section falls in a later chunk). སྡུད = nhiếp thâu, following the same verb rendered 'nhiếp thâu điều thiện' for དགེ་བ་བསྡུ་བ in the Bodhisattvabhūmi definition earlier in this chunk.

terms.vi: tinh tấn làm lợi ích chúng sinh
terms.note: p0524, third of the three divisions (announced only). Uses the fixed སེམས་ཅན = chúng sinh.

p0523, Sūtrālaṃkāra verse བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ཀྱིས་ནི་འཇིག་ཚོགས་འདས་ནས་གྲོལ. Every glossary entry is for the compound འཇིག་ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟ་བ / འཇིག་ལྟ = 'hoại tụ kiến'; here ལྟ་བ is absent and what is transcended is the perishable collection itself, not the view of it, so 'kiến' was NOT added. Rendered 'hoại tụ' on the same two components.

p0522. The defining term of vīrya, used 4× in this chunk (the ངོ་བོ definition, the Bodhicaryāvatāra pāda བརྩོན་གང་དགེ་ལ་སྤྲོ་བ་འོ, the Bodhisattvabhūmi definition, and སྤྲོ་བར་བྱེད in the armour passage). No glossary entry. 'hăng hái' follows existing corpus usage (c—, 'hăng hái', 'hăng hái lớn'). Because it is the head word of the whole pāramitā it should be pinned centrally.

p0523, Adhyāśayasaṃcodana verse. The glossary registers the reversed spelling གཉིད་རྨུགས = 'ngủ nghỉ hôn trầm' (p0137) and རྨུགས་པ = 'hôn trầm'. Rendered here in the order the source writes it; recorded so the sweep does not read the two orders as different terms.

p0522–p0523, Adhyāśayasaṃcodana verse. No bare entry; the glossary reaches བཟོ only inside c005's 'công xảo minh' (བཟོ་རིག་པ, one of the five sciences). Rendered with the same Sino-Vietnamese root so the two stay linked.

SCOPE REQUEST. Occurs 4× in this chunk (མཁས་པ་སུ་དག་...སྐྱོ, སྐྱོ་བས་ཕམ་པ་མེད, ཡོངས་སུ་སྐྱོ་མེད, སྙིང་རྗེས་སྐྱོ་བ་མེད), always as weariness at sustained effort — never as disenchantment with saṃsāra. glossary.json rules སྐྱོ་བ = 'nhàm chán' (scoped to p0109) and སྐྱོ་ཤས = 'lòng yểm ly', but also already registers སྐྱོ་བ་སྤངས་པ = 'dứt bỏ chán mệt' for exactly this weariness sense. 'chán mệt' chosen on that precedent and used uniformly here; a ruling should state the two-way split explicitly.
p0523, Pāramitāsamāsa verse. No glossary entry, though 'phi nhân' is already used in the translated corpus; registration gap only.

terms.vi: sự hành xử trong cõi hữu
terms.note: p0523, Sūtrālaṃkāra verse བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ཀྱིས་ནི་སྲིད་སྤྱོད་འདོད་པ་འཐོབ. Rendered component by component: སྲིད = cõi hữu, སྤྱོད་པ = 'hành vi · hạnh' (glossary). Deliberately NOT 'thọ dụng', which is reserved for ལོངས་སྤྱོད and appears in its own right four lines later. See flag — the line is obscure.
p0524. The glossary has བསྐལ་པ་གྲངས་མེད་པ་གསུམ = 'ba vô số kiếp' (literal, not 'a-tăng-kỳ') and བསྐལ་ཆེན = 'đại kiếp'; this is the two combined, since the source writes ཆེན་པོ.

terms.vi: nhân lên một trăm nghìn câu-chi lần
terms.note: p0524, the multiplier on the three incalculable aeons in the armour passage. Uses the glossary's བྱེ་བ = 'câu-chi' rather than 'ức'/'triệu', whose Vietnamese magnitude is ambiguous. འགྱུར = 'nhân lên ... lần'.

p0525, the source's contraction of རྫོགས་པའི་བྱང་ཆུབ. Keeps the fixed བྱང་ཆུབ = bồ-đề; 'viên mãn' follows the glossary's ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ = viên mãn. Distinct from བླ་མེད་བྱང་ཆུབ = 'vô thượng bồ-đề', which stands two sentences away.

p0522–p0525, 5× — it is the phrase the whole 'lợi ích / lỗi hại' section turns on (བརྩམས་པའི་ཕན་ཡོན་དང་མ་བརྩམས་པའི་ཉེས་དམིགས). 'khởi sự' chosen over 'phát khởi' so that བསྐྱེད་པ (བརྩོན་འགྲུས་བསྐྱེད་པའི་ཐབས, p0524) can keep 'phát khởi' and the two verbs stay separable.
p0524, 3× in the Sāgaramatiparipṛcchā quotation. The agentive of the glossary's ལེ་ལོ = 'sự biếng nhác'; 'giải đãi' avoided per that entry.

p0525, Pāramitāsamāsa verse, of the bodhisattva who dons the armour. Built from the glossary's བརྟུལ་ཞུགས = 'cấm hạnh' (provisional) and the ordinary-hero sense of དཔའ་བོ = 'dũng sĩ' (provisional, p0351) — deliberately not 'đấng Dũng Mãnh' (the Buddha epithet) nor 'bậc Thánh Dũng' (Āryaśūra), neither of which this is.
p0525, same verse. Uses the glossary's སྙིང་རྗེ = 'bi', with 'từ bi' withheld because བྱམས་པ is not present, per that entry's note. ངང་ཅན = 'có bản tánh'.

GLOSSARY CONFLICT, not a translator error. Text KEPT. glossary.json carries bare `སྐྱོ་བ` -> "nhàm chán" (provisional), but that entry's own note scopes it to the p0109 occurrence beside `སྐྱོ་ཤས` = "lòng yểm ly", i.e. weariness-with-saṃsāra, which is a virtue. The same glossary also carries `སྐྱོ་བ་སྤངས་པ` -> "dứt bỏ chán mệt" (p0062, glossed `ཡང་ཡང་འཆད་པས་མི་ངལ་བ`), i.e. weariness-with-repeated-effort, which is a fault. All four occurrences in c159 are unambiguously the second sense: p0523 `མཁས་པ་སུ་དག་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་སྟོབས་ཀྱིས་སྐྱོ` (l.39), `བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ལྡན་པ་སྐྱོ་བས་ཕམ་པ་མེད` (l.60), `ཡོངས་སུ་སྐྱོ་མེད་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ཆེ་ལྡན་ན` (l.70), p0525 `སྙིང་རྗེས་སྐྱོ་བ་མེད` (l.129). Applying "nhàm chán" here would invert the doctrinal valence — "one endowed with perseverance is not defeated by disenchantment" says the opposite of the verse. Requested ruling: split bare `སྐྱོ་བ` by sense, keeping "nhàm chán" for the saṃsāra sense (p0109) and licensing "chán mệt" for the effort/discouragement sense, aligned to the existing `སྐྱོ་བ་སྤངས་པ` entry.

NO ruling. Text KEPT. p0522 carries the definition of vīrya itself: `དམིགས་པ་དགེ་བ་ལ་དམིགས་ནས་རྣམ་པ་མངོན་པར་སྤྲོ་བ་སྟེ` (l.17), the Bodhicaryāvatāra citation `བརྩོན་གང་དགེ་ལ་སྤྲོ་བ་འོ` (l.20), and the Bodhisattvabhūmi gloss `སེམས་མངོན་པར་སྤྲོ་བ་ཕྱིན་ཅི་མ་ལོག་པ` (l.22); p0524-0525 `སེམས་ཀྱི་སྤྲོ་བ་སྔོན་དུ་འགྲོ་བའི་བསམ་པའི་གོ་ཆ` (l.105) and `སྤྲོ་བར་བྱེད་དེ` (l.108). Consistent with the registered `སྤྲོ་ཤུགས` -> "lòng hăng hái". Must be kept apart from `སྤྲོས་པ` -> "hí luận", a different word already in the glossary. Should be registered now: it recurs through the whole perseverance chapter, of which six further parts are still untranslated.

NO ruling for bare `མཆོག`. Five occurrences in c159, now uniformly "tối thượng": p0523 `བརྩོན་འགྲུས་མཆོག` (l.47), `བདེ་གནས་མཆོག` (l.49), `བྱང་ཆུབ་མཆོག` (l.54), `རྒྱུའི་གཙོ་བོ་དང་མཆོག` (l.63), p0525 `བྱང་ཆུབ་མཆོག་གི་སེམས` (l.127). The ruling matters because `དམ་པ (adjectival, bare)` IS registered as "tối thắng" (provisional) and is used for `བྱང་ཆུབ་དམ་པ` at l.130, two lines from `བྱང་ཆུབ་མཆོག` at l.127 — the two Tibetan words must stay separable. The `དམ་པ` entry's own note already asks for exactly this ruling and observes that "tối thắng" collides with the mchog/uttama family. Recommendation from the Tibetan: `མཆོག` -> "tối thượng", and settle `དམ་པ` into the "chân chính / chân nhân / Diệu" family so the collision closes.

NO bare entry. Text KEPT. p0523, Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra verse `བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ཀྱིས་ནི་འཇིག་ཚོགས་འདས་ནས་གྲོལ` (l.53) — here `འཇིག་ཚོགས` stands alone as the thing transcended, without `ལྟ་བ`. glossary.json registers only `འཇིག་ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟ་བ` -> "hoại tụ kiến"; "hoại tụ" is the same two components (壞聚) minus 見, so the compound entry's etymological gloss (`འཇིག་པ` = vô thường, `ཚོགས་པ` = nhiều) still reads. Registration owed.

NO ruling. Text KEPT. p0522, Adhyāśayasaṃcodana verse: `འཇིག་རྟེན་འདི་ན་བཟོ་གང་ཅི་ཡོད་དང༌། །འཇིག་རྟེན་འདས་བཟོ་གང་དག་ཅི་ཡོད་པ།` (ll.36-37) -> "công xảo" mundane and supramundane. Established Sino-Vietnamese 工巧 for śilpa. Distinct from the personal name `དགེ་བཤེས་ལྷ་བཟོ` already in the glossary, where `བཟོ` is not translated.

The pivot word of this whole chunk (8× on p0534–p0536: ཞུམ་པར་མི་བྱ, ཞུམ་ནས་བསྡད་པ, ཇེ་ཞུམ་དུ་འགྲོ, ཞུམ་པ་མེད་པ, ཡིད་ཤིན་ཏུ་ཞུམ). No glossary entry at all. 'thối chí' chosen because the corpus already uses it for this word (c112, c126 'thoái chí', c144 'ý lạc thối chí'), while c140/c111 use 'nản lòng' — the corpus is already split two ways, so a ruling is needed. Kept deliberately distinct from the registered སྒྱིད་ལུག = 'biếng trễ' and ལེ་ལོ = 'giải đãi'.

terms.vi: tích tập đội quân thuận duyên
terms.note: p0536, the in-body sa-bcad heading for the second part of the vīrya section. NOTE the ཚོགས trap: glossary.json registers ཚོགས = 'tư lương' (saṃbhāra), but here དཔུང་གི་ཚོགས is an army/host, not the two collections — and ཚོགས in the saṃbhāra sense occurs six times on p0534 of the same chunk. Rendered 'đội quân' here, 'tư lương' there. The registered entry's bo field is unscoped, so Phase 5's sweep will read this as drift without a scoping ruling.

p0536, fourth of the four powers of vīrya (Bodhicaryāvatāra VII). No entry. སྟོབས = 'lực' follows the registered སྟོབས entry. དོར་བ rendered 'buông bỏ' (laying aside / resting from the task), NOT 'xả' which would collide with སྤང་བླང = thủ xả.
p0536 (listed) and p0537 (defined: གང་ལ་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་བརྩམས་པ་དེ་ལས་མི་ལྡོག་པར་མཐར་འབྱིན་པ). Second of the four powers. No entry for བརྟན་པ at all.
p0536, third of the four powers, listed only in this chunk (defined in a later chunk). No entry for དགའ་བ.

p0535, three times — twice in prose (བློ་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་ན) and once in the Jātakamālā verse (བརྟན་པས་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་ན). No entry. 'nâng cao ý chí' preferred over 'phấn chấn' to keep the causative sense of deliberately raising one's own resolve, which is the argument of the passage.

p0535, Jātakamālā verse མཁས་པའི་གཟི་བརྗིད་བརྟན་པས. No entry. Rendered 'uy quang'; 'uy nghiêm' and 'oai lực' are the alternatives — 'oai lực' rejected because it would collide with སྟོབས = lực, which appears four times in the same chunk as a technical headword.
p0536, contrasted in the same clause with ཡོན་ཏན་མཚན་ཉིད་པ. No entry. Rendered descriptively rather than as 'tương tự công đức', to keep the pejorative force ('mere semblance') the contrast requires.

p0536. Here མཚན་ཉིད་པ is adjectival — a quality that actually meets its definition — which is NEITHER of the two senses the glossary's མཚན་ཉིད entry rules on ('tướng' = characteristic / 'định nghĩa' = definition). See flags: this is the flag the glossary's own note asks for.

terms.vi: lực của lòng tin ưa / lực của sự kiên định / lực của niềm hoan hỷ / lực của sự buông bỏ
terms.note: GAP - the four as a set (p0536 l.3, sa-bcad 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.4). Recorded as one set so they stay parallel and so this སྟོབས་བཞི is disambiguated from the two four-power sets already in glossary.json: the four opponent powers of purification (སྟོབས་བཞི = 'bốn lực', 6.2.3.1.1.2.2.4) and the four powers of bodhicitta generation (རང་གི་སྟོབས / གཞན་གྱི་སྟོབས / རྒྱུའི་སྟོབས / སྦྱོར་བའི་སྟོབས, p0364). That makes three distinct fours now.

GAP, no translator error. p0535, ཉེ་ལམ་འཚོལ་བ་སྐད་བྱེད་ན - the discouraged practitioner 'talking of looking for a short cut', which the text says indirectly harms the aspiring mind and directly harms the engaging mind. No entry. Rendering KEPT; register it. Pejorative in context, and 'con đường tắt' carries that.

terms.kind: ruling requested on an existing provisional entry
terms.note: The glossary's སེམས་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་པ = 'sách tấn tâm' carries the explicit note that the verb recurs elsewhere 'e.g. བློ་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་ན' and needs one fixed rendering. c162 IS that recurrence (p0535, prose L59 and Jātaka verse L68), now repaired to 'sách tấn'. Requesting the entry be promoted to a bare-verb ruling གཟེངས་བསྟོད་པ = 'sách tấn' so 'sách tấn tâm' / 'sách tấn ý chí' fall out of it by object. Please also rule whether བློ here is 'ý chí' (as rendered) or the glossary's བློ = 'trí' from the བློ་གྲོས / བློ / བརྟན་པ triad - the triad sense does not fit this context, where བློ is resolve, not intellect.

GAP for the bare prose verb. glossary.json has བསྐུལ་བ only inside the sūtra title ལྷག་བསམ་བསྐུལ་བ = 'Kinh Khuyến Phát Thắng Ý Lạc', whose note glosses བསྐུལ་བ = saṃcodana = 'khuyến phát'. c162 L114 (p0537, རང་ལ་རང་གིས་བསྐུལ་དགོས) previously used 'sách tấn', which belongs to གཟེངས་བསྟོད; it is now 'khuyến phát' on the strength of that title note. Needs confirming as the prose rendering, and needs to stay distinct from གཟེངས་བསྟོད = 'sách tấn'.

terms.vi: sự kiên định vs kiên cố
terms.note: c162 repaired the abstract-noun uses to 'sự kiên định' (L84-85 the second of the four powers, L135 བརྟན་པའི་སྟོབས) per the registered བློ་གྲོས / བློ / བརྟན་པ triad. Two adverbial/attributive uses in the same chunk were LEFT as 'kiên cố' - L28 དེ་ལྟར་བརྟན་པར་གནས་དེ་ནི 'Vị an trụ kiên cố như thế' (p0534, Bodhicaryāvatāra) and L68 མཁས་པའི་གཟི་བརྗིད་བརྟན་པས 'uy quang kiên cố của bậc trí' (p0535, Jātaka) - on the ground that the existing བརྟན་པོ (adjectival) = 'kiên cố' entry already covers predicative firmness, and its own note asks precisely for this ruling. Please settle whether adjectival/adverbial བརྟན་པ- joins the 'kiên định' family or stays 'kiên cố'; c162 and c137 will need a sweep either way.

The second of the three kinds of nhẫn, and the running subject of this whole chunk (~12×, p0515-p0518). Not in glossary. Follows c151, which renders the definition དང་དུ་ལེན as 'kham nhận'. Also appears as the noun phrase 'việc kham nhận khổ'. A ruling would settle whether the established Sino-Vietnamese 'an thọ khổ nhẫn' should be used for the heading form.

p0516 l1, སེམས་འཕངས་མཐོ་བ་བསྐྱེད་པ — the lofty resolve generated on realising that present suffering serves a great aim. No glossary entry; 'འཕངས' (elevation/pitch) rendered together with མཐོ་བ as one idiom rather than word-by-word. See flag.
p0518, twice: prose (སྡར་མ་འགའ་ཞིག) and the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse (སྡར་མའི་ཚུལ). The contrastive counterpart of དཔའ་བོ in the same simile; both must stay separable.

p0516 l1. Built as the direct counterpart of the fixed དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན = 'thiện tri thức'. glossary.json registers སྡིག་གྲོགས / སྡིག་པའི་གྲོགས་པོ = 'bạn ác' separately, so this is a distinct compound, not that one.
p0516 l1, མདུང་རྩེ་གསུམ་ལ་མཆོང་བ — a non-Buddhist austerity. Rendered descriptively; 'đinh ba' was avoided as it carries Vietnamese folk-religious colour the Tibetan does not.

p0516 l1, paired with the trident austerity. བསྟེན་པ rendered 'thờ phụng' (serve/attend on); 'tu khổ hạnh năm lửa' was avoided because the Tibetan does not say དཀའ་ཐུབ here — the word དཀའ་སྤྱད governs the whole pair instead.
p0518 l3, in the list of a monastic's requisites (ཆོས་གོས, བསོད་སྙོམས, མལ་ཆ, སྟན, ན་བའི་གསོས་སྨན, ཡོ་བྱད). No glossary entry.
p0518 l3, same requisites list; kept distinct from མལ་ཆ = ngọa cụ.
p0518 l3, same requisites list. Rendered descriptively rather than as the Sino-Vietnamese 'y dược'.

p0518 l3, first of the eight གཞི (bases) of suffering to be accepted. གནས is used twice in the same sentence — of the requisites and of what they are a basis for — so one Vietnamese word ('chỗ nương') carries both. Deliberately kept distinct from གཞི → 'nền tảng'. See flag.

p0518 l3, second of the eight bases. Note the source enumerates NINE, not the standard eight (འཇིག་རྟེན་ཆོས་བརྒྱད): མ་རྙེད་པ, མི་སྙན་པ, སྨད་པ, སྡུག་བསྔལ་བ, then འཇིག་པ ཟད་པ རྒ་བ ན་བ འཆི་བ. Translated as printed. See flag.
p0518 l3, paired with མི་དགའ་བ ('chán ghét') in the same clause; given its own word so the pair stays separable. c151 uses 'khiếp nhược ngã lòng' for ཞུམ་པ, which is a third term.

p0516 l1, of worldly people enduring the hardships of farming, trade and war. Distinct from བཟོད་པ (nhẫn / kham nhẫn) and from དང་དུ་ལེན་པ (kham nhận); note བསྲན also appears at p0514 in c156's range.
p0517, inside the Gaṇḍavyūha citation. ཐུབ་པར་དཀའ་བ = 'hard to be withstood/subdued'; rendered passively as the Tibetan has it, with no interpretive expansion inside the quotation.

p0517, inside the Ugraparipṛcchā citation: 'a mind like a ཤིང་བལ་གྱི་འདབ་མ' is to be abandoned. ཤིང་བལ = cotton, འདབ་མ = leaf/flake. Rendered literally; the sense (soft, blown about) is left for the reader, not glossed inside the quotation.
p0516 l1, སྔ་མ་ལས་བྱེ་བ་ཕྲག་འབུམ་འགྱུར་དུ. Built on the registered བྱེ་བ = 'câu-chi'; ཕྲག་འབུམ = a hundred thousand.
p0530, in the Sharawa quotation, paired with ཞུམ་པ (རང་ཁྱད་དུ་གསོད་པ = despising oneself). Kept distinct from སྨོད་པ / སྨད་པ = 'chê trách' in the Guṇāparyantastotra verse on the same page.
p0530, Guṇāparyantastotra verse (བདེར་གཤེགས་གོ་འཕང = 'quả vị Thiện Thệ'). Established Sino-Vietnamese (善逝); no glossary entry existed.
p0532, in the refutation of those who call it 'the hard path'. Built on the glossary's ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ = ba-la-mật (fixed) + ཐེག་པ = thừa. The compound itself had no entry.
p0532, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse, the Buddha as physician. Distinguished from plain སྨན་པ = 'thầy thuốc' used two verses earlier (སྨན་པ་ཀུན, p0532).

UNCERTAIN - see flag. p0530, closing Tsongkhapa's endorsement of the Sharawa quotation (གསུང་སྟེ་ཤིན་ཏུ་མད་པ་ཡིན་ནོ). Rendered 'hết mực tuyệt diệu'. Recorded so the same rendering is used at the other five corpus occurrences of མད་པ, all of which are endorsements of a master's saying and one of which pairs it with ལེགས་པ (ཤིན་ཏུ་ལེགས་ཤིང་མད་པས).
p0533, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse (སྐྱོ་ངལ་ཀུན་སེལ་བ). Built on the glossary's སྐྱོ་བ = nhàm chán, which is used for every other སྐྱོ occurrence in this chunk.

NO entry exists. This gap is what let the two renderings diverge inside one chunk (L74 'thầy thuốc' for སྨན་པ་ཀུན vs. L87 'y vương' for སྨན་པ་མཆོག, now corrected). 'thầy thuốc' is corpus-wide practice (c013, c014, c016, c023, c059, c075). Recommended ruling: སྨན་པ = 'thầy thuốc', with the epithet སྨན་པ་མཆོག = 'bậc thầy thuốc tối thượng' recorded explicitly so the elevated form is not re-invented as 'y vương' / 'dược vương' elsewhere. Both occurrences are Bodhicaryāvatāra verse (p0532-p0533).

NO entry for bare ཐེག་པ; only compounds are registered (ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོ = 'Đại thừa', ཐེག་པ་དམན་པ = 'Tiểu thừa', ཐེག་པ་མཆོག = 'thừa tối thượng', ཐེག་པ་ཐུན་མོང་བ, ཐེག་པ་ཆུང་ངུ — all provisional). Here p0532 ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པའི་ཐེག་པ་པ → L101 'người theo Ba-la-mật thừa'. The 'Ba-la-mật' half correctly follows the fixed ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ entry; wording KEPT. A ruling should cover bare ཐེག་པ = 'thừa' and the agentive suffix ཐེག་པ་པ = 'người theo … thừa', which is also unregistered.
p0526 l.1. The name the Akṣayamati sūtra gives to the undaunted armour. Kept as a quoted phrase in the Vietnamese, since the Tibetan marks it as the sūtra's own designation.

terms.vi: Kinh Vô Tận Tuệ Thỉnh Vấn
terms.note: p0526 l.1. glossary.json already has བློ་གྲོས་མི་ཟད་པས་བསྟན་པ = 'Kinh Vô Tận Tuệ Sở Thuyết' (p0366); here the Tibetan writes ཞུས་པ, not བསྟན་པ, so the genre word is rendered 'thỉnh vấn' on the pattern of the registered བློ་གྲོས་རྒྱ་མཚོས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Hải Tuệ Thỉnh Vấn'. Whether the two Tibetan forms name the same sūtra is not decided here.
p0526 l.3, second of the three kinds of vīrya. Wording matched to c150's already-used 'giới nhiếp thiện pháp' (ཆོས་སྡུད་ཀྱི་ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས) so the two parallel triads agree.

terms.vi: tinh tấn làm lợi ích chúng sinh
terms.note: p0526 l.3, third of the three kinds of vīrya. Matched to c150's 'giới làm lợi ích chúng sinh'.

p0529, epithet of the Buddha. Built from the glossary's སྐྱེས་བུ = 'bậc trượng phu' and ཚད་མ = 'lượng' (registered inside ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པ = 'đã trở thành lượng'). The paraphrase 'bậc đáng tin cậy' was avoided because it drops pramāṇa; the compact Sino-Vietnamese 'lượng sĩ phu' was avoided because it conflicts with the registered 'bậc trượng phu'. See flags — the result is opaque.

p0527 l.1, in the sa-bcad མཐུན་རྐྱེན་དཔུང་གི་ཚོགས་བསག་པ = 'tích tập đạo quân thuận duyên'. The military image is kept (it continues the གོ་ཆ / armour image of the section). Distinct from the glossary's དཔུང་གཉེན = 'người thân trợ giúp'.
p0529, the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse list, and སྦྲང་བུ་སོགས in the prose just before it. No glossary entries. Rendered as ordinary Vietnamese creature names, no Sino-Vietnamese.

p0528 l.1, prose and the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse. glossary.json fixes རྒོད་པ = 'trạo cử', but its own note scopes that to བྱིང་རྒོད, the meditative fault; here རྒོད་པ stands beside ཅལ་ཅོལ་སྨྲ་བ (idle chatter) as a worldly distraction, so 'trạo cử' would be a category error. Same treatment as the existing དབང་པོ་མི་རྒོད་པར་བྱ་བ entry, which also declines 'trạo cử'.

terms.vi: còn thì giờ / chẳng còn thì giờ
terms.note: p0527 l.1 and p0528 l.1, the thought that defines ཕྱི་བཤོལ་གྱི་ལེ་ལོ ('sự biếng nhác trì hoãn', already registered). Rendered plainly rather than as 'nhàn rỗi'.
p0528 l.1 and p0529. No glossary entry for the compound; རྟེན = 'thân y' follows c005 ('công đức nơi thân y ấy').

p0529, བདག་གིས་བརྩོན་པ་མ་བཏང་ན་... སྙམ་དུ་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་དེ. glossary.json has སེམས་གཟེངས་བསྟོད་པ = 'sách tấn tâm'; here the object is not stated in the Tibetan, so 'sách tấn [tâm mình]' with the object bracketed.
p0529, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse. Built from the fixed བྱང་ཆུབ = bồ-đề and the glossary's སྤྱོད་པ = 'hành vi · hạnh'. Not conflated with the title སྤྱོད་འཇུག = 'Nhập Bồ-tát Hạnh'.
p0527 l.1, of Śāntideva's treatise (གོ་སླ་ཞིང་སྐྱོང་བདེ). Uses the corpus's སྐྱོང་བ = 'hộ trì' (c027). The object of སྐྱོང་བ is not stated in the Tibetan and is not supplied.

terms.bo: རྒོད་པ (non-śamatha sense: frivolity/laughter, in the BCA distraction list)
terms.skt: kutūhala / hāsya (contextual); cf. auddhatya for the śamatha fault
terms.note: p0528 twice: དོན་མེད་པའི་ཅལ་ཅོལ་སྨྲ་བ་དང་རྒོད་པ་སོགས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གཡེང (L78) and the BCA verse རྒོད་སོགས་ལ་ཁྱོད་ཅི་ཕྱིར་དགའ (L85). WORDING KEPT, ruling requested. The existing entry རྒོད་པ -> 'trạo cử' (provisional) is scoped by its own note to p0091 བྱིང་རྒོད, the meditative fault. Here རྒོད་པ is paired with ཅལ་ཅོལ་སྨྲ་བ (meaningless chatter) as a worldly amusement one 'delights in' — the frivolity sense, not auddhatya. The glossary already records this exact kind of context split for the same word: དབང་པོ་མི་རྒོད་པར་བྱ་བ -> 'khiến các căn không buông lung', whose note says the trạo cử ruling 'is NOT applied here'. Requested: either a scoped second entry for the frivolity sense, or an explicit ruling that trạo cử covers all occurrences. Neighbouring རྣམ་གཡེང is already conformant as 'sự tán loạn'.

p0574. The unabbreviated form of the citation formula; glossary.json carries only འཕགས་པ་དགོངས་འགྲེལ = 'Thánh Giải Thâm Mật'. Same title, same Vietnamese — registered so the long form is not mistaken for a different work.

p0575 ×2 (ཡང་དགོངས་འགྲེལ་ལས།, དགོངས་འགྲེལ་ལས།). glossary.json has དགོངས་འགྲེལ = 'luận giải mật ý' as a common noun and འཕགས་པ་དགོངས་འགྲེལ = 'Thánh Giải Thâm Mật' as the title; the bare form used as a citation tag has no entry, so the common-noun reading would be wrongly applied here. Rendered without the འཕགས་པ honorific because the Tibetan drops it.

p0575, ཤེར་ཕྱིན་མན་ངག་ཏུ་བཤད་དོ — cited as the authority for śamatha/vipaśyanā abandoning nimitta/dauṣṭhulya respectively. Built from registered pieces: ཤེར་ཕྱིན = 'Bát-nhã Ba-la-mật' (title sense) and མན་ངག = 'khẩu quyết'. Distinct from the registered ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པའི་མན་ངག་གི་བསྟན་བཅོས = 'bộ luận khẩu quyết về ba-la-mật'; a ruling on whether these two name the same work would be useful.

p0575, inside the Saṃdhinirmocana verse སྐྱེ་བ་པོ་ཡིས་ལྷག་མཐོང་དང་... No entry. Deliberately NOT 'chúng sinh', which the glossary reserves for སེམས་ཅན, and not the glossary's སྐྱེ་བོ = 'người / hạng người', since the Tibetan here is the longer སྐྱེ་བ་པོ. Low confidence on the Vietnamese form; a ruling is wanted.

p0573 outline item 2 and the p0575 heading (ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་ཀུན་གྱི་སྡུད་བྱེད་དུ་བསྟན་པ). The agentive nominal 'that which gathers'. glossary.json has several སྡུད་པ entries but all are cited titles (Bảo Đức Tạng) or ཆོས་སྡུད compounds; nothing covers this.

terms.vi: Lợi ích của việc tu tập tịnh chỉ và thắng quán
terms.note: p0573, first of the six sub-topics of 6.2.3.1.11.2.

terms.vi: Trình bày hai điều chỉ quán là cái thâu nhiếp hết thảy các định
terms.note: p0575. Body heading; the outline list on p0573 states it with དེ་གཉིས་ instead of ཞི་ལྷག་གཉིས་ — same section, wording differs in the source.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học đặc biệt nơi hai ba-la-mật sau cùng
terms.note: The chunk's own section heading, 6.2.3.1.11.2 (p0573).

terms.vi: Con xin cung kính đảnh lễ dưới chân chư vị Chí Tôn chân chính, những bậc đầy đủ lòng đại bi.
terms.note: p0573, the homage opening the śamatha–vipaśyanā division. glossary.json registers the variant with ...རྣམས་ལ་གུས་པས... ; this occurrence reads ...རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཞབས་ལ... ('at the feet of'), so 'dưới chân' was added to reflect ཞབས་ལ. Registered so the two variants are not treated as drift.

GAP — no entry; wording KEPT. p0574 `ཇི་ལྟ་བའམ་ཇི་སྙེད་པའི་དོན་སོ་སོར་འབྱེད་པའི་ཤེས་རབ་དགེ་བ་རྣམས` → line 40 `các trí tuệ thiện biện biệt riêng từng nghĩa như sở hữu tánh hoặc tận sở hữu tánh`. glossary.json registers three neighbours — `སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པའི་ཤེས་རབ` = trí tuệ giản trạch, `སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ` = giản trạch, `སོ་སོར་དཔྱོད་པ` = sự quán sát từng phần — but nothing for `སོ་སོར་འབྱེད་པ`, and the `སོ་སོར་དཔྱོད་པ` note already asks for a ruling fixing the split across the `སོ་སོར་…` family. `biện biệt` is a fourth Vietnamese word in that family. Not a translator error: c174 uses the registered `trí tuệ giản trạch` correctly for the genuine `སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པའི་ཤེས་རབ` at lines 46 and 48 (p0574 l.1, p0574 l.3), so within this chunk `འབྱེད་པ` and `རྟོག་པ` stay distinguishable. The ruling should decide whether `འབྱེད་པ` keeps a separate word or collapses into `giản trạch`; note `འབྱེད་པ` also appears inside the p0270 vipaśyanā definition, so the family will keep meeting.

p0567, in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse བསྡུ་བའི་དངོས་པོ་བཞིར་ཤེས་བྱ. No headword; the glossary registers only བསྡུ་བཞི / བསྡུ་བ་བཞི = 'bốn nhiếp pháp'. Rendered 'nhiếp sự' matching c173, which already uses 'bốn nhiếp sự' and 'các nhiếp sự'. Register so the sweep sees བསྡུ་བཞི = nhiếp pháp and བསྡུ་བའི་དངོས་པོ = nhiếp sự as a deliberate split, not drift.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học bốn nhiếp pháp vốn làm chín muồi tâm tương tục của người khác
terms.note: Outline s184, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.2, level 6 → '#'. Wording matched to c141, which introduced this section in its division sentence ('tu học bốn nhiếp pháp vốn làm chín muồi tâm tương tục của người khác') and rendered the sibling s177 as 'Cách thức tu học sáu ba-la-mật làm chín muồi Phật pháp của chính mình'. NOTE the outline heading reads སིན་བྱེད, not སྨིན་བྱེད — see flags.

terms.vi: Thể tánh của bốn nhiếp pháp
terms.note: Outline s185, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.2.1, level 7 → '##' (relative nesting inside the chunk). ངོ་བོ = 'thể tánh' per the existing provisional entry.

terms.vi: Lý do xác lập thành bốn
terms.note: Outline s186, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.2.2, level 7 → '##'. བཞག་པ = 'xác lập'; རྒྱུ་མཚན = 'lý do', following the glossary's རྒྱུ་མཚན་དགུ = 'chín lý do'.

terms.vi: Tác dụng của bốn nhiếp pháp
terms.note: Outline s187, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.2.3, level 7 → '##'. The heading falls at the very end of p0567; its body is in c172, which opens 'Thứ ba. Nếu hỏi: bốn nhiếp pháp này làm được gì nơi người đáng được điều phục?' — so c172 carries no heading of its own for it. བྱེད་ལས (karma/function) rendered 'tác dụng'; keep distinct from ལས = nghiệp.

terms.vi: sự bố thí đại trân bảo
terms.note: p0566, inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi quotation. Rendered literally; the referent is left unresolved — see flags.

p0567 l.5, closing verse: བསྡུ་བའི་དངོས་པོ་བཞིར་ཤེས་བྱ། → 'hãy biết đó là bốn nhiếp sự' (c171 line 43). No entry exists; the nearest are བསྡུ་བཞི / བསྡུ་བ་བཞི → 'bốn nhiếp pháp' and དངོས་པོ → 'sự vật'. WORDING KEPT — the rendering is the established Sino-Vietnamese 攝事 and already matches c173, which has 'Bốn nhiếp sự được chủ trương' and 'Bằng các nhiếp sự' (c173 l.31, inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi quote). The ruling should record the pháp/sự split DELIBERATELY: བསྡུ་བ་བཞི / བསྡུ་བཞི = 'bốn nhiếp pháp', but བསྡུ་བའི་དངོས་པོ་བཞི = 'bốn nhiếp sự', so that the Tibetan's own distinction between the bare four and the four *vastu* stays visible in Vietnamese instead of collapsing into one phrase. Note the glossary's existing དངོས་པོ → 'sự vật' does not compose here; this is a fixed compound, not དངོས་པོ + modifier.

p0566 l.5 (in the five-fold announcement) and p0567 l.7 (as the sa-bcad heading བསྡུ་བཞིའི་བྱེད་ལས།), rendered 'tác dụng' / 'Tác dụng của bốn nhiếp pháp' (c171 lines 19 and 47). glossary.json has NO entry for བྱེད་ལས in any form. WORDING KEPT — c172, which owns that section, opens by citing this same heading as 'Tác dụng của bốn nhiếp pháp', so the two chunks already agree; this is a missing registration, not a divergence. Register the bare term and the heading together: བསྡུ་བཞིའི་བྱེད་ལས། → 'Tác dụng của bốn nhiếp pháp'.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học bốn nhiếp pháp vốn làm thành thục tâm tương tục của người khác
terms.note: PRECEDENT CONFLICT that needs one ruling, raised by the fix above. The glossary rules སྨིན་པ → 'thành thục' (provisional), and c172/c173 follow it; c171 has now been brought into line. But translation/c141 lines 17 and 19 already render this very heading pair with 'chín muồi': 'tu học các ba-la-mật vốn làm chín muồi Phật pháp của chính mình, và tu học bốn nhiếp pháp vốn làm chín muồi tâm tương tục của người khác' and the H3 'Cách thức tu học sáu ba-la-mật làm chín muồi Phật pháp của chính mình'. If the ruling stands, c141 needs the same substitution in both places (and its sibling heading རང་གི་སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་ཆོས་སྨིན་བྱེད་... with it) or the announcement in c141 will not match the headings it announces. Registering the heading itself would settle both halves at once. Separately: the sa-bcad prints སིན (གཞན་རྒྱུད་སིན་བྱེད) where the body has སྨིན (གཞན་གྱི་རྒྱུད་སྨིན་པར་བྱེད་པ) — a source spelling variant/typo, translated as སྨིན and not normalised in the file.

p0564, བདག་མེད་པའི་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་དོན་སྤྱིའི་སྒོ་ནས་འཇལ་བ — the generic/conceptual image through which suchness is inferentially cognised, contrasted in the same clause with མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་པ (direct manifestation). No glossary entry. 'nghĩa tổng' (義總) chosen over 'tổng tướng' so that སྤྱི་མཚན (sāmānyalakṣaṇa) stays available separately.

p0564 (མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་པའི་སྒོ་ནས་འཇལ་བ) and p0564 again (སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་པའི་ཤེས་རབ, rendered 'trí tuệ trong đó tánh không đã hiện tiền'). No entry. Kept off 'hiện chứng', which the glossary already attaches to མངོན་པར་རྫོགས་པར་འཚང་རྒྱ་བ.

p0564, Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra verse. No entry. འཕགས་པ = Thánh, མཆོག = tối thắng, on the pattern of the glossary's ཞིང་དམ་པ = 'ruộng tối thắng'. No honorific or gloss ('đức Phật') added — the verse does not name anyone.

p0564, Sūtrālaṃkāra verse. Same Vietnamese as the glossary's ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པ = 'Nhất Thiết Trí'; the abstract suffix ཉིད is not separately reproduced, since 'Nhất Thiết Trí tánh' would be heavier than the verse line will carry. Registering so the two spellings are not read as different terms.

p0564, twice — in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse (གཞན་དག་ཚར་བཅད) and in Tsongkhapa's gloss (བསྟན་པ་ལ་མ་མོས་པ་རྣམས་ཚར་བཅད་པའི་ཕྱིར). Glossary holds only the compound བདུད་ཚར་བཅད་པའི་སྔགས = 'chú tiêu diệt ma'; 'tiêu diệt' is too strong for refutation of opponents by reasoning, hence 'chiết phục'.
p0564, Sūtrālaṃkāra verse, paired with ཚར་བཅད. No entry. The established Sino-Vietnamese for saṃgraha in the 'taking others under one's care' sense.
p0564, one of the རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ (glossary: 'năm minh xứ'). No entry, though c005.md already uses 'thanh minh' inside the list of the four minh xứ. Registering the existing usage.
p0564. No entry; matches c005.md's 'nhân minh'.
p0564. No entry; matches c005.md's 'công xảo minh'.
p0564. No entry; matches c005.md's 'y phương minh'.

terms.vi: mục đích riêng biệt / [mục đích] không riêng biệt
terms.note: p0564, the contrast that closes the five-sciences passage: each science has its own specific purpose (བྱེ་བྲག་པ), while seeking all of them for buddhahood is the purpose common to all (བྱེ་བྲག་མེད་པ). Rendered as a literal negated pair rather than 'riêng / chung', so the Tibetan's own morphology stays visible. The word དགོས་པ occurs only once, on the first member; supplied bracketed on the second.

p0564. ཤེས་རབ here is NOT inside ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན, so the glossary rule gives 'trí tuệ', not 'bát-nhã'; སྦྱིན་པ = bố thí (fixed). Part of the recurring formula whereby each pāramitā contains all six.

p0565, མདོ་སྔགས་གཉིས་ཀའི་ལམ་གྱི་གཞུང་ཤིང་ཕར་ཕྱིན་དྲུག — literally the central beam/axle-tree of the path. No entry. 'trục chính' and 'nòng cốt' were the alternatives; 'cột trụ chính' keeps the architectural image the Tibetan uses.

terms.vi: sự tổng nhiếp các yếu điểm
terms.note: p0565 final line, ཉམས་ལེན་གྱི་གནད་སྡོམ. Built from the glossary's གནད = 'yếu điểm' and the registered སྡོམ་ཆེན་པོ = 'sự tổng nhiếp lớn' (སྡོམ read as 'epitome/summation', not 'vow').

p0565, གཞན་ལྔ་ལ་ཉམས་སུ་ལེན་པའི་རིམ་པ་ནུབ་སྣང་བས — the practice sequence of the other five perfections 'appears to have set/declined'. No entry. Rendered 'xem ra đã mai một' to keep the evidential སྣང་བ ('appears') rather than asserting it flatly.

p0564 l.1 (L22), སྒྲ་དང་གཏན་ཚིགས་རིག་པ. glossary.json registers only the set རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ = 'năm minh xứ' and the member ནང་རིག་པ = 'nội minh'; the other four members are unruled. 'thanh minh' matches c005 L62 and c167 L19 verbatim, so this is existing corpus practice, not drift. Text KEPT.

p0564 l.1 (L22), བཟོ་དང་གསོ་བ་རིག་པ. glossary.json has བཟོ = 'công xảo' (provisional, from the p0522 Adhyāśayasaṃcodana verse) but no ruling for the five-sciences member བཟོ་རིག་པ. 'công xảo minh' matches c005 L62 and c167 L19 and is consistent with the existing བཟོ entry. Text KEPT.

p0565 (L32), གཞུང་ཆེ་བ་རྣམས་ནས་འབྱུང་བའི་དོན. glossary.json registers གཞུང་ཆེན་མོ = 'đại luận'; the Tibetan form HERE is ཆེ་བ, not ཆེན་མོ, so the variant wording is arguably licensed. But the corpus is already split on the same referent: 'các bộ luận lớn' at c011 L26/L32 vs 'các đại luận' at c010, c011 L28, c032, c033, c034, c181. Phase 5's consistency sweep will hit this. ONE ruling needed — either (a) ཆེ་བ and ཆེན་མོ are the same lemma and both render 'các đại luận', or (b) they are kept apart deliberately. Wording NOT changed unilaterally.

terms.kind: glossary inconsistency — correct the ENTRY, not the chunk
terms.note: p0564 l.1, དེ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱང་སངས་རྒྱས་འཐོབ་པའི་ཕྱིར་དུ་ཚོལ་བ (L22). The registered entries སངས་རྒྱས་ཐོབ་པ / སངས་རྒྱས་ལ་ཐོབ་འདོད write 'chứng đắc Phật quả' (word order Phật quả), but the corpus almost uniformly writes 'quả Phật': c009, c113, c124, c126, c129, c131, c132, c133, c136, c161. c170 follows the corpus majority. The glossary entry is the outlier and should be corrected to 'quả Phật' rather than the chunk being changed. (Note also the entry's own open question about whether the supplied 'quả' — absent from the Tibetan, which has only སངས་རྒྱས — should be bracketed; c170 supplies it unbracketed, matching every one of the ten corpus occurrences.) Text KEPT.
p0579. The glossary has only the abbreviated Tibetan བྱང་ས = Bồ-tát Địa; this is the full form of the same title, rendered identically so the two stay one text.
p0580, one of the two shared objects of śamatha and vipaśyanā in the Saṃdhinirmocana fourfold ālambana list. Built on the glossary's དངོས་པོ = sự vật and the མཐའ of ཞི་བའི་མཐའ = biên tế tịch tĩnh.

terms.vi: sự thành tựu trọn vẹn mục đích
terms.note: p0580, the fourth of the Saṃdhinirmocana ālambana list, paired with དངོས་པོའི་མཐའ. Rendered literally from the Tibetan (དགོས་པ = mục đích, ཡོངས་སུ་གྲུབ་པ = thành tựu trọn vẹn) rather than importing the Chinese-derived 'sở tác thành biện'. See flag.
p0579, in the Bhāvanākrama definition of śamatha. Used in c166/c172/c175 already but has no glossary entry; ~heavily recurrent through the śamatha division, so it should be recorded centrally.
p0579-0580. Follows the glossary's existing gap-note for the bare དཔྱོད་པ = thẩm sát. Kept distinct from རབ་ཏུ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ = phân biện tột cùng, which appears in the same passages.

terms.vi: phân biện tột cùng / phân biện tột cùng các pháp
terms.note: p0579. A three-member ladder appears verbatim in the Bodhisattvabhūmi quote — འབྱེད་པ / རབ་ཏུ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ / ཆོས་རབ་ཏུ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ — and must stay three separable Vietnamese terms. Rendered to match c175, which uses 'phân biện' / 'phân biện tột cùng' for the same pair inside the Saṃdhinirmocana quote.
p0581, in རིག་པའི་གསལ་ཆའི་ངར = 'sức mạnh của phần sáng tỏ nơi sự nhận biết' — the wrong criterion Tsongkhapa is refuting. Must stay visibly separate from དྭངས་ཆ in the same paragraph.
p0581, སེམས་ཀྱི་དྭངས་ཆ. Deliberately NOT 'phần trong sáng', which is too close to གསལ་ཆ = phần sáng tỏ — the two occur four lines apart in an argument that turns on their not being the same thing.

p0581, ཡིན་ལུགས་རྟོགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ = 'cái kiến chứng ngộ thật lý'. No entry existed. Kept off 'thật tánh' (= དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད) and 'chân như' (= དེ་བཞིན་ཉིད) so the three stay separable. Provisional — a better Vietnamese may exist and this recurs in the vipaśyanā division.

p0581, མངོན་སུམ་གྱིས་འགྲུབ་པ = 'thành lập bằng hiện lượng' — the epistemological sense (direct perception as a means of knowledge), distinct from the glossary's མངོན་སུམ་དུ་མཆོད་པ = cúng dường hiện tiền.

terms.vi: làm cho thành một dòng tương tục / làm cho thành định
terms.note: p0579, the 8th and 9th of the nine mental abidings, cited by name inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi quote. Rendered literally; the full nine-fold list is set out later at source/clean/lamrim.txt l.4711ff and should govern once that chunk is translated.

terms.vi: phần sáng tỏ nơi sự nhận biết
terms.note: p0581 l.1, ×2 (`རིག་པའི་གསལ་ཆའི་ངར་མེད་པ`, `གསལ་ཆའི་ངར་ཡོད་མེད`) -> c176 l.35. No entry. Load-bearing for this polemic: the whole rejected position turns on whether the 'clarity aspect' has force. Rendered analytically rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese compound; needs pinning together with the next term.

p0581 l.1, `བྱིང་བ་དང་བྲལ་བའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་སེམས་ཀྱི་དྭངས་ཆ་ངེས་པར་འོང་བ` -> c176 l.35. No entry. Paired in the same sentence with `རིག་པའི་གསལ་ཆ` above, and the argument depends on the two being distinguishable (གསལ་ཆ vs དྭངས་ཆ); one ruling should cover both, and should keep དྭངས་ཆ clear of `གསལ་བ` = sáng tỏ.

p0579 l.1, inside the Bodhisattvabhumi citation `རྒྱས་པར་མཁས་པ་དང་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱིས་འཇུག་པའི་བར` -> 'sự thâm nhập bằng thiện xảo và bằng trí tuệ' (c176 l.15). glossary.json rules `མཁས་པ` = 'bậc học giả' (the person) and, separately, `ཐབས་མཁས་པ` = 'phương tiện thiện xảo'; neither covers the bare abstract noun paired with ཤེས་རབ, which is 'skill/expertise', not a scholar. 'thiện xảo' is consistent with the second entry. NOTE: `མཁས་པ` now has four entries in glossary.json (bare = bậc học giả; 'in the MMK verse' = bậc trí; 'contrastive with བྱིས་པ' = bậc trí; 'in verse' = bậc trí), each asking for the same merge. One ruling should state the full split at last: paṇḍita/scholar = bậc học giả; wise-vs-foolish and verse register = bậc trí; adjectival = khéo léo; abstract noun (esp. beside ཤེས་རབ or ཐབས) = thiện xảo.

GLOSSARY DEFECT, pre-existing. p0581 l.1, `རྒྱལ་ཚབ་ཀྱི་བསྟན་བཅོས` -> 'bộ luận của bậc Nhiếp Chính' (c176 l.35). glossary.json keys the BARE form `རྒྱལ་ཚབ` to 'bậc Nhiếp Chính tôn quý' inside the merged entry 'རྒྱལ་ཚབ / རྒྱལ་ཚབ་དམ་པ', and a separate `རྒྱལ་ཚབ་དམ་པ` entry exists as well. The Tibetan here has no `དམ་པ`, so dropping 'tôn quý' is the faithful reading and the chunk is right; the merged entry conflates the two forms. Split into `རྒྱལ་ཚབ` = 'bậc Nhiếp Chính' and `རྒྱལ་ཚབ་དམ་པ` = 'bậc Nhiếp Chính tôn quý', and drop the duplicate headword.
p0571 (Atiśa verse) and p0572 (prose). No entry. Follows corpus precedent in c094 and c130, which both write 'Tư Lương đạo' beside 'Gia Hành đạo'.

p0571-p0572, 8×, always paired with རྗེས་ཐོབ. glossary.json registers མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'nhập đẳng dẫn' (the verbal act, p0447). Here it is the noun naming one of two phases, so the bare 'đẳng dẫn' is used, with 'nhập đẳng dẫn' kept for the verse line མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པའི་དུས་དག་ཏུ. Corpus uses 'nhập đẳng dẫn' in c166, c169, c177.
p0572, 5×. No entry. The counterpart of མཉམ་གཞག; also used to unpack the contraction མཉམ་རྗེས = 'đẳng dẫn và hậu đắc'.
p0571 l.2, p0572 l.1 and l.4. Contraction of མཉམ་གཞག + རྗེས་ཐོབ; rendered by expanding both members, since Vietnamese has no matching contraction.

terms.vi: tám thí dụ về huyễn hóa
terms.note: p0572, Atiśa verse. Uses the registered provisional སྒྱུ་མ = 'huyễn hóa'. The verse only names the number; the eight are NOT enumerated in the Tibetan and were not supplied.

p0572, ཆོས་ཟབ་མོ་ལ་ངེས་པར་སེམས་པ — the aspect of བཟོད་པ that occurs in equipoise. No entry. Built from the registered ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết' plus སེམས་པ; deliberately NOT the registered སེམས་པ = 'tư' (cetanā), which is a different, Abhidharma sense.

p0571, རང་གི་སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་རྒྱུ་ཚོགས. glossary.json registers ཚོགས = 'tư lương' (saṃbhāra) and a second scoped sense 'các việc'. This is a third: ཚོགས as the plain 'collection' inside the compound རྒྱུ་ཚོགས. 'tư lương nhân' would import the saṃbhāra reading the compound does not require.
p0571, Atiśa verse, modifying ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན་དྲུག. No entry.

p0572, 3×. The pāramitās 'maintained/guarded' during one phase or the other. No entry; kept distinct from བསྒོམ་པ = 'tu' in the very next clause of the same sentence, which the Tibetan contrasts with it.

NO ENTRY of any kind in glossary.json. Rendered "đẳng dẫn" (定引/等引) throughout c173 — prose and both Atiśa verses. མཉམ་རྗེས (the dvandva contraction) is rendered as the pair "đẳng dẫn và hậu đắc". Also occurring: མཉམ་གཞག་ལངས་པ = "xuất khỏi đẳng dẫn" (arising from equipoise). This pair structures the whole ཕྱིན་དྲུག/མཉམ་རྗེས passage and recurs across the śamatha/vipaśyanā divisions, so a ruling is needed now; register མཉམ་གཞག and མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ as one form so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the spelled-out variant as drift.

NO TERM ENTRY. The only བསྡུ་བ entries in glossary.json are TITLES — "བསྡུ་བ" = Nhiếp Quyết Trạch (Viniścayasaṃgrahaṇī) and "བསྡུ་བ (bare, as cited title)" = Nhiếp — neither of which applies here. c173 has the ordinary noun/verb three times on p0571: ཆོས་ཀྱི་བསྡུ་བ = "sự nhiếp bằng pháp", བསྡུ་བ་གཉིས་ཀྱི་སྒོ་ནས = "qua cửa của hai sự nhiếp", ཟང་ཟིང་གིས་བསྡུ་བ (implied by ཟང་ཟིང་དང་ནི་ཆོས་ཀྱིས) = "nhiếp bằng tài vật". Needs its own term entry so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the common noun as a mis-rendered title.

terms.vi: làm thành thục / làm thành thục trọn vẹn
terms.note: NO ENTRY for the causative verb; glossary has only the noun སྨིན་པ = "thành thục" (provisional, p0479), whose note insists it stay distinct from གོམས་པ = "thuần thục". c173 follows that split exactly: སྨིན་པར་བྱ་བ / སྨིན་བྱེད = "làm thành thục", ཡོངས་སུ་སྨིན་པར་བྱེད = "làm thành thục trọn vẹn" (ཡོངས་སུ་ = trọn vẹn), against གོམས་པ = "thuần thục". Load-bearing for the whole nhiếp-pháp section and present in both cited passages (the verse སེམས་ཅན་སྨིན་བྱེད་ལམ and the Bồ-tát Địa quotation), so the causative and the ཡོངས་སུ་ intensifier should be registered explicitly.

terms.vi: Người thâu nhiếp đồ chúng cần nương vào đó
terms.note: Outline s188, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.2.4, level 7 -> '##'. འཁོར = 'đồ chúng' follows c171, which renders འཁོར་...སྡུད་པ as 'thâu nhiếp đồ chúng' in the immediately preceding section. བརྟེན་པ = 'nương vào' per the glossary's བསྟེན་པ = nương.

terms.vi: Giải thích rộng thêm đôi chút
terms.note: Outline s189, path 6.2.3.1.11.1.2.5, level 7 -> '##'. ཅུང་ཟད = đôi chút, རྒྱས་པར = rộng, བཤད་པ = giải thích. The chunk c173 draft already uses this same Vietnamese for the same heading, so fixing it here keeps the two halves of the split section consistent.

terms.vi: ái ngữ đi cùng với cách thức thế gian / ái ngữ đi cùng với việc chỉ dạy pháp chân chánh
terms.note: p0568-p0569, the two-fold division of སྙན་པར་སྨྲ་བ (glossary: ái ngữ, provisional). Recorded as a pair so the two stay parallel; ཚུལ = cách thức, ལྡན་པ = đi cùng với.
p0568, in the list of worldly-manner ái ngữ. ཁམས = the bodily constitution/elements; the idiom is enquiring after someone's health. No glossary entry.

p0569. Built on the glossary's སྐྱོ་བ་སྤངས་པ = 'dứt bỏ chán mệt', whose note already scopes སྐྱོ་བ to weariness at teaching repeatedly (not saṃsāric disenchantment) — the same sense here, of a teacher facing a very dull student. དང་དུ་ལེན་པ = to accept/take on willingly.
p0569, glossing the four noble truths as what is taught to a matured continuum. ཕུལ = the topmost/best; ཡང་དག་ = chân chánh, matching ཡང་དག་པའི་ཆོས = 'pháp chân chánh' earlier in the same paragraph.

p0569, སྙན་པར་སྨྲ་བའི་སྒོའོ = 'các cửa của ái ngữ'. Rendered literally rather than as 'phương diện', following c173 which renders བསྡུ་བ་གཉིས་ཀྱི་སྒོ་ནས as 'Qua cửa của hai sự nhiếp thọ' in the very next chunk of the same section.

p0568 l.1 (སྙན་སྨྲས་ནི...) and l.9 (སྙན་སྨྲ་ལ་གཉིས་ལས), c172 l.13 and l.35. The abbreviated form the source uses throughout this passage. glossary.json registers only the full སྙན་པར་སྨྲ་བ = 'ái ngữ' (provisional) and ཚིག་སྙན་པ = 'ái ngữ'; note that p0569 l.1 uses the full སྙན་པར་སྨྲ་བ in the same chunk, so both forms occur side by side. Vietnamese identical and correct; registering the short form only so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as an unruled term.

p0569 l.1, ཐེ་ཚོམ་བྱུང་བ་རྣམས་བསལ་བའི་ཕྱིར་དུ་ཆོས་འཆད་ཅིང་འབེལ་གཏམ་བྱེད་པ, c172 l.37 ('giảng pháp cùng đàm luận'). No entry under either the Tibetan or the Vietnamese. Rendering kept; requesting a ruling (candidates: 'đàm luận' / 'luận đàm' / 'chuyện trò về pháp'), and note it must stay distinct from the plain གཏམ 'lời/chuyện' used elsewhere in the same sentence (ཆོས་ཀྱི་གཏམ, ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཀྱི་གཏམ).

p0587, inside the Samādhirāja verse (ལྷག་སྤྱོད་འདི་ན་ཏིང་འཛིན་བསྒོམ་པ་བཞིན). Read as a personal name, not as the literal 'hạnh thù thắng': the same verse is cited again at p0686 as ལྷག་སྤྱོད་ཀྱིས་ནི་ཏིང་འཛིན་འདིར་བསྒོམས་བཞིན, where ཀྱིས makes it unambiguously the agent, i.e. a person. The Sanskrit identification (Udraka) is a lexical equivalence, not something the Tibetan states — see flag.

p0587. glossary.json fixes ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ = 'Kinh Tam-muội Vương'; here the Tibetan writes འཕགས་པ and no མདོ, so rendered *Thánh Tam-muội Vương* on the corpus pattern for འཕགས་པ + title (*Thánh Giải Thâm Mật*, c083/c132/c174). Registered so the འཕགས་པ-prefixed form is not later 'corrected' to the plain 'Kinh'.
p0587. Built on the glossary's དཀོན་མཆོག་བརྩེགས་པ = 'Bảo Tích' plus འཕགས་པ = 'Thánh', same pattern as *Thánh Giải Thâm Mật*.

p0585, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse (དེ་ཉིད་རིག་པས་དོན་མེད་གསུངས) — the ergative agent of གསུངས, so a person, not the abstract 'sự rõ biết chân như'. དེ་ཉིད = chân như follows corpus usage (c177 'thật tánh / lẽ thật' for དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད); no entry existed.
p0585, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse ཉོན་མོངས་མཆེ་བའི་ཕྲག་ན་གནས. Rendered 'những chiếc nanh của phiền não'. No entry.

p0586, ཉོན་མོངས་མངོན་གྱུར་འགོ་གནོན་པ་ཙམ. Deliberately kept distinct from རྣམ་པར་གནོན་པ = 'chế phục', which occurs twice on the same page inside the Bhāvanākrama and Saṃdhinirmocana quotations; the two Tibetan verbs must stay separable in Vietnamese.
p0585, the simile ཡུར་བ་བདེ་མོ་ལ་ཆུ་དྲངས་པ་ལྟར = 'như nước được dẫn vào con mương thuận tiện'. No entry.
p0587, in the Bodhisattvapiṭaka quotation. ཕུང་པོ here is 'mass/heap', not the skandha sense the glossary registers as 'uẩn', so 'khối' rather than 'uẩn'.

terms.vi: trí thanh tịnh trọn vẹn / trí thanh tịnh hoàn toàn
terms.note: p0587, both on the same page (the first in Kamalaśīla's prose, the second twice in the Ratnakūṭa verse). ཡེ་ཤེས = 'trí' per the glossary (kept apart from ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ); the two different intensifiers are given two different Vietnamese words so they stay distinguishable.

terms.kind: term - compound unregistered; parent entry needs scoping
terms.note: L55, inside the Bodhisattvapiṭaka quotation (བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའི་སྡེ་སྣོད་ཀྱི་ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་འདི). glossary.json registers only bare རྣམ་གྲངས -> 'pháp môn' (provisional), whose own note already asks for a ruling on which Vietnamese covers which sense. Here the sense is unambiguously dharmaparyāya = a scriptural exposition, i.e. the 'pháp môn' sense proper. Wording KEPT and consistent with the corpus; register the compound.

L55 (འགྲོ་བ་དྲུག་གི་འཁོར་བ -> 'luân hồi của sáu thú'). No entry. The bare འགྲོ་བ is registered as 'chúng sinh' (provisional, itself flagged as colliding with the fixed སེམས་ཅན); that ruling cannot apply inside this compound, where འགྲོ་བ is a destiny, not a being. Wording KEPT; needs its own entry.

L31 (བཀོལ་དུ་རུང་བའི་ལས་རུང་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་ཕྱིར). glossary.json registers only the full ལས་སུ་རུང་བ -> 'kham nhậm' (provisional, kept distinct from khinh an / ཤིན་སྦྱངས). The contracted ལས་རུང used here is unregistered. Rendering is consistent with the registered entry; register the short form so Phase 5's sweep matches it.

terms.vi: Cách thức tu học tĩnh lự ba-la-mật
terms.note: Outline path 6.2.3.1.11.1.1.5, the sa-bcad heading this chunk opens on. Built on the sibling headings already registered: ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức tu học giới ba-la-mật' (c149) and བརྩོན་འགྲུས་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức tu học tinh tấn ba-la-mật' (c159). Uses the glossary's provisional བསམ་གཏན = tĩnh lự and the fixed ཕར་ཕྱིན = ba-la-mật. NOTE the series is not uniform: glossary.json's བཟོད་པའི་ཕར་ཕྱིན་ལ་བསླབ་ཚུལ entry and translation/c151.md line 15 insert 'nơi' ('Cách thức tu học nơi nhẫn ba-la-mật') while c149/c159 do not. I followed the majority form without 'nơi'; a sweep is owed.
p0551, first of the śrāvaka-common qualities produced by dhyāna. No entry, but 'thần thông' is the uniform corpus form (c018, c040/c041, c075, c096, c108, c130, c138, c158). Registration owed.

p0550-p0551 across the page break. This is the soteriological/meditative-attainment sense (the vimokṣas listed beside abhijñā), NOT the biographical sense that glossary.json's རྣམ་པར་ཐར་པ = 'hành trạng' entry was made for. It matches the scoping request already recorded from c037 ('giải thoát (soteriological) · hành trạng (biographical)') and the fixed ཐར་པ = giải thoát. The entry should finally be split into its two senses.

p0551, third member of མངོན་ཤེས་དང་རྣམ་ཐར་དང་ཟད་པར་དང་ཟིལ་གནོན. No entry. Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 遍處. The Tibetan here is the bare ཟད་པར without སྐྱེ་མཆེད, so the identification rests on the standard four-member list rather than on the words alone — see flags. Note the same syllables ཟད་པར occur elsewhere in the corpus as the ordinary verb 'cạn kiệt' (e.g. p0252 སྡིག་པའི་གངས་ཀྱང་ཟད་པར་འགྱུར), so the entry must be scoped to this list.

p0551, fourth member of the same list. No entry. Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 勝處. Literally 'áp phục / chế ngự'; as with ཟད་པར the Tibetan is the bare word without སྐྱེ་མཆེད — see flags.

p0550, the third of the five sub-topics (བསམ་གཏན་གྱི་རབ་དབྱེ). No entry, but 'sự phân loại' is the settled corpus form for this sa-bcad item across the pāramitā chapters (c141, c143, c149, c150, c151, c159). Wording follows c159 verbatim. Registration owed.

p0551, ...འགོད་པའི་ཕྱིར་དུ་སློབ་པ་ལ་སྐུལ་བྱེད་ཡིན་པས. GAP: glossary.json has སྐུལ་བྱེད only inside the title སྐུལ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས = 'Đà-la-ni Khuyến Phát', whose note glosses it 'the one that urges → Khuyến Phát', plus the bare verb བསྐུལ་བ = 'khuyến phát' (provisional, from c162). The agentive noun is rendered on that basis. IMPORTANT: the parallel summary paragraphs in the other pāramitā chapters do NOT have this word — the kṣānti one (p0521, c158) reads ...འགོད་པར་འདོད་པའི་རྩ་བ་ཡིན་པས and was correctly rendered 'gốc rễ'. The Tibetan differs, so the Vietnamese must differ; a sweep should not collapse them. The same སྐུལ་བྱེད also stands in the vīrya summary on p0549 (chunk c165, not yet translated) and should be rendered identically there.
p0550, inside the Bodhisattvabhūmi definition of dhyāna, in apposition to སེམས་རྩེ་གཅིག་པ་དགེ་བ. Rendered literally; no interpretive expansion added inside the quotation.

p0550, ཡོན་ཏན་མངོན་པར་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་བསམ་གཏན. No entry. The མངོན་པར prefix is carried by 'hiện tiền' so this stays distinguishable from bare བསྒྲུབ་པ = 'thành tựu', which occurs three times in the same paragraph.

NOT a new term — flagged for a central ruling, not a per-chunk one. glossary.json carries two entries that overlap: མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ = 'nhập đẳng dẫn' (p0447) and སེམས་མཉམ་པར་བཞག་པ / མཉམ་པར་འཇོག་པ = 'tâm an trú trong định', whose own note says the term 'needs a CENTRAL ruling, not a per-chunk one' and expressly weighs 'đẳng dẫn' against it. c166 line 30 has the bare form གང་ལ་མཉམ་པར་བཞག་ན and followed the entry matching that bare form, giving 'khi nhập đẳng dẫn vào đó'. Wording kept; the collision needs settling once for the whole corpus, after which affected chunks can be swept.
p0577, ལུས་སེམས་ཤིན་ཏུ་སྦྱངས་པའི་དགའ་བདེ. Compound of དགའ་བ + བདེ་བ; rendered as the established pair 喜樂.
p0576, ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་ཀུན་གྱི་སྤྱི་ཆིངས — the general binding/framework covering all samādhis. No entry; rendered descriptively rather than with a coinage.

terms.vi: phân biện / phân biện tột cùng
terms.note: p0577-p0578. First two of the nine acts of vipaśyanā in the Saṃdhinirmocana, then glossed by the text itself: རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ discerns ཇི་སྙེད་པ, རབ་ཏུ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ discerns ཇི་ལྟ་བ. Kept off 'giản trạch', which the glossary reserves for སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ, so the two Tibetan verbs stay separable in Vietnamese. The same term reappears at p0578 in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse ཆོས་རབ་རྣམ་པར་འབྱེད་པ → 'phân biện tột cùng các pháp' (deliberately not the conventional 'trạch pháp', which the Tibetan does not write).

terms.vi: chu biến tầm tư / chu biến tứ sát
terms.note: p0577 (in the sūtra list) and p0578 (Asaṅga's gloss). The text's own gloss fixes the pair: རྟོག་པ་ནི་རྩིང་བར་རྟོག་པ ('tầm tư một cách thô sơ'), དཔྱོད་པ་ནི་ཞིབ་པར་དཔྱོད་པ ('tứ sát một cách tinh tế') — i.e. vitarka/vicāra. ཡོངས་སུ = 'chu biến'. See flag: this fixes རྟོག་པ = 'tầm tư' and དཔྱོད་པ = 'tứ sát' for this technical pair only, against the glossary's རྟོག་པ = 'phân biệt' (vikalpa) and the still-open ruling on bare དཔྱོད་པ.
p0577, seventh of the nine acts of vipaśyanā. Rendered from components (བྱེ་བྲག = sai khác, འབྱེད་པ = phân biệt/phân định). See flag on its collision with རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ.

p0578, མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པ་ནི་བདེན་འཛིན་མ་ཡིན — the text denies that vipaśyanā's 'apprehending signs' is bden 'dzin. No glossary entry although this is a pivot term of the vipaśyanā division. Kept short ('chấp thật') rather than 'chấp thật hữu', which adds a word the Tibetan does not have.

p0578, ཡུལ་གྱི་སྤུ་རིས་འབྱེད་པ = 'sự phân định các nét sai biệt của cảnh'. Literally the fine lines/markings by which one object is told from another; rendered descriptively, no established Sino-Vietnamese found.
p0577, སེམས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་པ་སྤངས་ནས inside the Saṃdhinirmocana definition of vipaśyanā. Rendered 'hành tướng' (行相), the established rendering of ākāra as a mental aspect; NOT 'hình tướng'.
p0578. The already-registered དཀོན་མཆོག་སྤྲིན = 'Kinh Bảo Vân' cited here with འཕགས་པ prefixed; 'Thánh' added for that prefix and 'Kinh' dropped because the Tibetan writes neither མདོ here.

terms.vi: dùng chân lăn [bộ kinh ấy] đi
terms.note: p0577-p0578, the Hashang anecdote. དྲིལ = rolled; rendered literally with the object bracketed, because the Tibetan supplies no object. Avoided 'đá', which would add violence the verb does not carry.

terms.vi: con đường thể nhập sự song vận hợp nhất
terms.note: p0576, inside the last Bhāvanākrama quotation. Built on the registered ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བ = 'song vận hợp nhất'; འཇུག་པ = 'thể nhập'.

terms.vi: thẩm sát / chu biến thẩm sát
terms.note: c175 has been unified on the registered `དཔྱོད་པ` = "thẩm sát", and the compound `ཡོངས་སུ་དཔྱོད་པ` follows it as "chu biến thẩm sát" so the Asaṅga gloss (`དཔྱོད་པ་ནི་ཞིབ་པར་དཔྱོད་པའོ`, p0578 l.3) still explains the head of the compound. Two things still need one ruling: (a) `ཡོངས་སུ་དཔྱོད་པ` has no entry of its own — the natural Sino-Vietnamese pair for `ཡོངས་སུ་རྟོག་པ` / `ཡོངས་སུ་དཔྱོད་པ` is "chu biến tầm tư" / "chu biến tứ sát" (尋思 / 伺察), which reads better than "chu biến thẩm sát" but breaks identity with bare `དཔྱོད་པ` = "thẩm sát"; whichever way it is ruled, c175 must be swept with it; (b) the split the existing `དཔྱོད་པ` note already records (c083 "quán sát" vs c125/c134 "thẩm sát") is untouched, and "thẩm sát" is still also the head word of the registered `ངེས་པར་རྟོག་པ / ངེས་རྟོག` = "thẩm sát quyết định".

p0578 l.3, the Asaṅga gloss: `རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པས` → "kèm theo tầm tư", `རྟོག་པ་ནི་རྩིང་བར་རྟོག་པ་ཡིན` → "Tầm tư là sự tầm tư một cách thô sơ". glossary.json registers only `རྟོག་པ` = "phân biệt" (vikalpa), and its note says the entry was made "in the Hashang position" — which is exactly the sense the same chunk uses at line 43 (`རྟོག་པ་གང་ཡིན་ཐམས་ཅད` → "phàm cái gì là phân biệt"). The vitarka sense, paired with `དཔྱོད་པ` and defined as the coarse member of the pair, is a genuinely different word. Register the split rather than overwriting either wording.

p0576 l.3 and p0578 l.3, cited as the sūtra itself → c175 lines 29 and 47. glossary.json registers the prefixed `འཕགས་པ་དགོངས་འགྲེལ` = "Thánh Giải Thâm Mật" (title) and, separately, bare `དགོངས་འགྲེལ` = "luận giải mật ý" (term) — but that term entry is from p0084 (`དྲི་མ་མེད་པའི་གསུང་རབ་དང་དགོངས་འགྲེལ`), a different sense ("commentary on the intent"). There is no ruling for the bare form AS the title. No word for "Kinh" is supplied because the Tibetan has none, matching the `འཕགས་པ་དགོངས་འགྲེལ` entry's own reasoning.

p0577 l.3 (nine-item vipaśyanā list) and p0578 l.3 (Asaṅga gloss) → c175 lines 39, 45. No entry. Must be ruled together with `ཡོངས་སུ་དཔྱོད་པ` above, since the Asaṅga gloss defines them as the coarse/subtle pair.

terms.vi: sự phân biệt / sự phân biệt sai khác
terms.note: p0577 l.3, members 7 and 9 of the nine-item vipaśyanā list → c175 line 39, where they stand four words apart. Neither has an entry, and bare `རྟོག་པ` = "phân biệt" (registered) occurs again at line 43. Three distinct Tibetan terms are converging on "phân biệt" with nothing keeping them apart — the exact failure decisions.md §5 was written to prevent. All nine members of the Tibetan list are present and in order, so nothing is lost; the wording is kept pending a ruling that separates the three.
p0577 l.1 → c175 line 35. No entry. The twelve branches of scripture; established Sino-Vietnamese. Keep and register.

terms.vi: phân định các nét sai biệt
terms.note: p0578 l.3, `ཡུལ་གྱི་སྤུ་རིས་འབྱེད་པའོ` → c175 line 45, "sự phân định các nét sai biệt của cảnh". No entry. Descriptive rendering chosen so it does not collide with the `འབྱེད་པ` = "phân biện" family in the same paragraph.

p0582 l.1. Composed from the registered provisionals ལས་སུ་རུང་བ = 'kham nhậm' (kept distinct from khinh an / ཤིན་སྦྱངས) and རླུང = 'khí' (registered only inside རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ and the medical triad). No entry for the compound.

p0582 l.3, ...བསྒྲུབ་པ་ལ་ཤེས་བྱེད་ཡང་དག་པ་ཅི་ཡང་མེད་དོ. No entry for ཤེས་བྱེད. Literally 'that which makes [one] know' — the evidence establishing a thesis. 'chứng cứ' chosen as the least interpretive; deliberately NOT 'lượng' (ཚད་མ) or 'năng lập' (སྒྲུབ་བྱེད), which are different Tibetan words. See flags.

p0584, twice (བདག་མེད་པའི་དོན་གྱི་སྤྱི and བདག་མེད་པའི་དོན་སྤྱི). No entry. The conceptual generic image of an object. Rendered componentially (དོན = nghĩa, སྤྱི = tổng) rather than 'nghĩa cộng tướng' or a paraphrase like 'hình ảnh khái niệm'. See flags.
